products.label: JPL Horizons, satellite ephemerides SAT455 to SAT459
products.process: Take every confirmed Saturn moon in the retained JPL catalogue that has no object package and has a Horizons code; ask Horizons for its geometric position relative to Saturn's centre at the world's epoch; draw one dot at that position.
limitations: A dot's colour and size are not measurements; the moons are a few kilometres across and would be invisible at scale.
S/2009 S1 and S/2009 S2 have no Horizons ephemeris and are not drawn.
